message:
I remember a particularly blustery winter night when the power went out, and my grandkids were visiting. Instead of panicking, I turned it into an impromptu camping experience in the living room. We gathered blankets, lit some candles, and made shadow puppets on the walls. 

Through the howling winds outside, we shared stories and enjoyed hot cocoa, turning what could have been a dreary situation into a cozy little adventure. It reminded me that a little preparedness can turn storms into special moments. 

What’s your favorite way to make the best of a stormy situation?
